title: CmdPal: Bookmark {placeholder} field retains last-entered value on every subsequent open
summary: The issue provides a repeatable scenario, expected behavior, affected version, and unusually specific source-level tracing of the bookmark placeholder lifecycle. It is suitable for a full design review, while the fast judgment does not independently validate the proposed mechanism.

status.label: Design in progress
status.detail: A detailed implementation-grade design is being prepared. No maintainer action is exposed until the design is complete and validated.

judgment.rationale: The issue provides a repeatable scenario, expected behavior, affected version, and unusually specific source-level tracing of the bookmark placeholder lifecycle. It is suitable for a full design review, while the fast judgment does not independently validate the proposed mechanism.
evidence: Labels include Issue-Bug and Product-Command Palette.
The body gives a reproducible bookmark URL containing a placeholder and describes the value persisting across later opens.
The body identifies BookmarkListItem, BookmarkPlaceholderPage, StringParameterRun, and SearchBar.xaml as relevant implementation points.
The issue explains that the expected behavior is an empty or intentional default value on each open unless remembering the last value is documented or configurable.
No comments, assignees, linked fix, or existing ownership are present.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a full design investigation to confirm the placeholder-state lifecycle and define reset behavior and regression coverage.
